|strategy=By Doug Taylor<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/ricolie.html</ref>

So who's the best Light side pilot in the game? There have been some great ones, like [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] and Wedge, but NEVER before have we seen one that adds a phenomenal FOUR to a ship's power. The only time we've seen this amazing level of skill was when [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] was piloting his Custom TIE.

Until now.

[[Ric Olie]] is much more than just an incredible pilot, however. He forfeits for 6 (8 when [[Security Control]] is in play). He's got solid power and ability of 3. And when he's piloting the [[Queen's Royal Starship]], he can use whatever Force you have available to wipe out enemy attrition. Now that's "getting out alive".

Ric is an awesome pilot in any deck. With [[Squadron Assignments]] out, you'll want to get him aboard the Queen's transport as soon as you can to bolster any space contingent.

Combos:

Power 7, Forfeit 13, draws one battle destiny, immune to attrition &lt; 4 and [[Lateral Damage]], and built-in attrition reduction, plus Hyperspeed of 7. Sounds like a rival for the Super [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]].
